The '''containment section''' was a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility in [[Section X]], a region of the [[Belsavis prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Located in the area designated [[Block 53]], the subterranean vault stored mutated creatures, and was raided by the [[Dread Host]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The containment section appears in Section X, a Daily Area added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 1.5.<ref name="TOR" />
